bio: I build software and apps with AI agents, and I’m building R7 Orbit, a desktop app for directing them. I’m a product designer, and most of what I design is AI-assisted tools, workflows and interactive experiences. I like taking a messy process and turning it into something structured and easy to use, which means a mix of product thinking, interaction design, prototyping, automation and visual design. More and more, I also build the tools and skills my agents work with, so they can take on more of the work themselves.
